name: Principal Report on Twins Placement Appeal
description: When a parent appeals the classroom placement of twins/multiples, the principal provides a written report stating the basis for the placement recommendation.
quote: The principal shall promptly provide the Superintendent or designee with a written report including a statement of the basis for the principal's recommendation so that the Superintendent or designee can make a final determination on the matter, which shall be communicated to the parent/guardian.
